title: Mafungu Akaparadzanisa Ropa
intro: Fungidzira mafashamo makuru achikwira pamusoro penyika, Areka ichiyangarara pasi, uye mweya mumwe chete uchisiyiwa panze nesarudzo. Akasungwa neropa kumuporofita asi akaparadzaniswa nekutenda, munhu uyu akatarisana nekudanwa kwekupedzisira kuti apinde muchikepe mvura ichikwira. Unogona here kuziva kuti ndiani ari shure kwekuramba?
clues: Ndiri mwana wemumwe wevaprofita vakuru vaAllah, imba yekutenda yandakasarudza kusiya.
Ndakararama munguva yeMafashamo Makuru, apo kusatenda kwakafukidza nyika semvura.
Ndakaramba kukwira muAreka nevatendi apo baba vangu vakandidana.
Ndakati ndaizotsvaga nzvimbo yekupotera mugomo kuti ndidzivirirwe kubva mumvura.
Ndakaudzwa kuti hapana chaigona kudzivirira kubva kumurairo waAllah pazuva iroro kunze kwetsitsi.
Ndakasvikirwa nemafungu ndikanyura, uye baba vangu vakaudzwa kuti handisi wemhuri yavo yakarurama.

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
